item: Row 439: country codes converted on the way in, the staged copy never written
summary: The merge's first step rewrote the staged copy's country codes in place, so under R834 it waited for the staged copy's whole integrity walk. plan_staged_country_codes now decides the same conversion in temp tables (a spelling map; in-memory copies of law_documents' key columns and of the law and places alternates) and every merge read of a country column goes through _cc. Differential test against the old step over 48 corpora: identical working copy, report and staged-file digest. Measured on 200,000 articles, alpha-2 backup into an alpha-3 store, 4 CPUs: 4 GB cap plain 237.9 s to 134.6/149.4 s, keyed 291.9 s to 161.3/161.2 s; no cap plain 177.0 to 117.6 s, keyed 229.2 to 118.6 s. Anonymous peak RSS 618 to 617 MB; the higher VmHWM on plain (1,861 to 2,474 MB) is the walk's file map now overlapping the merge, reclaimable file pages. The plan refuses an encrypted connection whose temp_store is not MEMORY (R825), and the encrypted memory check counts 300 B per staged law document.
